Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.NotificationService
public class NotificationService extends Object
Notifications for all three portals (UC4 View Notifications, shared by the User actor).

Other services call send(java.lang.String, com.hkust.marketplace.models.NotificationCategory, java.lang.String) or sendToAdmins(com.hkust.marketplace.models.NotificationCategory, java.lang.String) when an event happens (UC4 Special Requirement 1). These calls do not check the logged-in user, because the system, not the user, sends notifications. The board methods (getMyNotifications(), markRead(java.lang.String), markAllRead(), getUnreadCount(), getMyCategories()) work only on the logged-in user's own board.

  • Method Details

    • send

      public Notification send(String recipientUsername, NotificationCategory category, String content)
      Puts a notification on the user's board, timestamped now. If the admin deleted that account, nothing is sent: deals and listings kept as records can still name it, and there is nobody left to tell.
      Returns:
      the notification, or null if the account was deleted
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if there never was such an account

    • sendToAdmins

      public void markRead(String notificationId)

    • markAllRead

      public void markAllRead()
      Marks every unread notification on the logged-in user's board as read: UC4 step 3 for all of them at once (team decision, assumptions register 91). It is one transaction, so all are marked or, when the account can no longer act, none.
